capabilities: Create field-and-value rules for frontmatter labels
Colour matching values in note Properties
Add icons and filename colours in the File Explorer
Colour enabled folders from the selected File Explorer field
Apply the same rules to Bases Table and Card views
disambiguation: Not a data visualization tool; it only adds colours, icons and filename colouring to metadata values.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed rules live in an external User Guide; the author accepts donations via Buy me a coffee.
intentEvidence: Reuses the same rules in native Bases Table and Card views, including embedded Bases.
problem: Obsidian renders frontmatter values as plain text, so scanning a vault for status or state at a glance is hard.

relations.evidence: Optional local import of Metadata Menu Select values; Metadata Menu is not required for normal use.

summary: Rule-based visual engine that colours frontmatter values in Properties, the File Explorer, enabled folders, and native Bases Table and Card views.
